description: Offline and enhanced-for-leads click conversions posted to the Google Ads API UploadClickConversions method, including the JSON Conversion payload. Conversion adjustments are vendor/google-ads-conversion-adjustments. The image pixel on /pagead/conversion is a different pack.

params.name: conversions
params.fix_hint: Send at least one ClickConversion in `conversions`.

params.name: partialFailure
params.description: Google documents `partial_failure` as required, and the upload guides say to always send true.

params.name: conversionAction
params.description: It is the conversion action resource name, and every uploaded click conversion requires it.

params.name: conversionDateTime
params.description: Google documents the conversion time with a timezone offset as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm`.

params.name: gclid
params.description: Google click ID. A click-ID upload needs exactly one of `gclid`, `gbraid`, or `wbraid`.

params.name: gbraid
params.description: App-to-web click identifier from iOS. Alternative to `gclid`.

params.name: userIdentifiers
params.description: Hashed user identifiers for enhanced conversions for leads. The upload service accepts `hashedEmail` and `hashedPhoneNumber` only, at most five.

params.name: userIdentifiers[].hashedEmail
params.description: Email must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase and trim the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: userIdentifiers[].hashedPhoneNumber
params.description: Phone must be E.164 and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: currencyCode
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code for `conversionValue`. Google documents both together.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`, together with `conversionValue`.

params.name: conversionValue
params.description: It is the conversion value for the advertiser. Google documents it together with `currencyCode`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `1.0`, with no currency symbol, together with `currencyCode`.

params.name: userIpAddress
params.description: It is the customer IP on the landing page after the click, sent unhashed. Google documents the device address, not the advertiser server.

rules.message: The conversion has no click ID and no `userIdentifiers`. Google documents a `gclid`, `gbraid`, or `wbraid` for click-ID uploads, or hashed user identifiers for enhanced conversions for leads.
The conversion sends `conversionValue` without `currencyCode`. Google documents the ISO 4217 code together with the value.
The conversion sends `currencyCode` without `conversionValue`. Google documents both together.
rules.fix_hint: Add `conversionValue` as a number, with no currency symbol.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Google requires email as `hashedEmail`, SHA-256 hashed after normalization.
rules.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send `userIdentifiers[].hashedEmail`.

rules.message: `userIpAddress` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Google documents it as the customer IP, unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address of the customer's device.
